ops.title: Exec-storm round two: codex-ask, cc-notes pack, cc-slack pack, launcher PATH order
ops.body:
Second round of the Nov 12 exec-storm cuts (owner: "fix all of these in addition to whatever else you discover").

codex-ask (cc-skills #4679, v1.15.5, installed via brew cask + codex@skills 1.15.5): lane liveness probes read the start time with sysctl kern.proc.pid instead of `/bin/ps -o lstart= -p N`. Before: one ps exec per probe (51 in a 5.5 s eslogger window). After: 0. Checked by running `codex-ask --ps` under sandbox-exec with /bin/ps exec denied: a running lane still read `running`.

cc-notes pack (cc-notes #285, v0.76.17): `cc-notes answer list/match` results are cached per argv, keyed on the inode/mtime_ns/size of <commondir>/cc-notes-managed/authority-v3.db and -wal, for the repo the CLI reads (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or cwd, joined with $CCN_REPO), 600 s TTL, LRU 128. Bypassed when the git config names a storage key in any case or the authority db is missing. Per prompt: first prompt 4 spawns -> 2; a repeated identical read 1 -> 0 while the authority is unchanged; steady state about 1 (match on new prompt text).

cc-slack pack (cc-slack #372, v0.19.163): call_bin execs the artifact binrun recorded at ~/.daemonkit/binrun/resolved/<resolved descriptor path> when the record is newer than bin/cc-slack.binrun. It falls back to bin/cc-slack for BINRUN_BIN, a newer live plugin sibling, an undecodable record, or a spawn OSError. Per agent-inject/start/stop/report call: 4 (before cc-skills #4670) -> 2 (after) -> 1. The pack's record lives under the symlink-resolved plugin path because the pack runs the launcher by its resolved path; the first call per version writes it.

Launcher gap 2 (cc-skills #4689): an older binrun on PATH no longer shadows the pinned runner. The launcher bootstraps the pinned runner first. When a PATH binrun exists, it writes $RUNNER_DIR/.bootstrap-claimed and allows one 60 s download with no retries, then falls back to the PATH binrun on any failure. That covers a pinned exec failure, and the claim (no older than the descriptor) skips retries until the plugin updates. With no PATH binrun the behavior is unchanged: full retries, exit 1 on failure. Rendered to every launcher copy on main: captain-hook, cc-context, cc-inbox, cc-orchestrate, cc-present, cc-review, cc-slack, slop-cop, cc-skills codex and slop-cop. Each ships with its repo's next release. On a machine with a stale PATH binrun, each launcher call drops from 3 execs (bash, binrun, artifact), with no record ever written, to 2 after the one-time bootstrap. The pack path drops to 1.
